I am an old man now, and my body is not strong like it was before. This small plot of mine is only 0.09 hectares, but it is important for feeding my family, so I will work it carefully with my sons and grandchildren. I will apply some urea and DAP that I receive from the farmers' cooperative, and I will also put cow manure because the soil near the homestead benefits from it. I plant my own saved maize seed that I have kept for many years, not the new hybrid seed, because I know it will grow in this soil, and I do not need chemicals or irrigation since God sends the rain.
